invariant.definition: block-constancy: all tile coords within each block equal (exact for the invariant sector)

mathematical_object.state_space: R^d (d=262144), block-constant invariant sector Omega (packed 8x8 NEON/FMA microkernel regime)
mathematical_object.quotient_space: R^r (r=65536), class representatives (packed-A/B block accumulation from simd_v6_validation.c)
mathematical_object.projection: pi(x) = [x[c*tile] for c in 0..r-1]  (first element per block)
mathematical_object.reconstruction: sigma(q) = [q[c] for c for _ in range(tile)]  (repeat each rep tile times)

parameters.note: C-cluster silicon evidence (this device): simd_v6_validation.c PACKED_NEON_8x8 checksum-matched kernel-8x8 -> N=128 bit-exact (max_abs=0, checksum deterministic) 56.11x kernel / 22.67x end-to-end; N>=256 exactness gate FAIL (residual ~2e-4) so certified claim is bounded to the exact N=128 sector; simd_sweep_v3 bit-exact 7.2-15.5x

quotient.definition: exact block-constant projection with pi(T(x)) = Tbar(pi(x)) on invariant sector

reconstruction.definition: sigma(q) = tile-replicate each quotient coord back to d-dim full vector
